en.title: Amber Sand-Winds and the Cradle of Frozen Time
en.premise: In a bustling desert trading hub, a young junk dealer comes into possession of a peculiar broken pocket watch—one that refuses to tick. Yet, its hands point toward a singular destination: the legendary 'Ice Castle,' hidden deep within the scorching wastes. Seeking the remnants of a lost civilization, he sets sail on a steamship, embarking on a journey to defy destiny in the space between silence and chaos.

zh.title: 琥珀色的沙风与冰封时刻的摇篮
zh.premise: 在沙漠的贸易都市中，一名经营废品的青年偶然得到了一块“永远不会走动的破旧怀表”。然而，表针所指向的，却是沉睡在灼热之地最深处的传说之所——“冰之城”。为了寻回失落文明的遗产，青年登上了蒸汽帆船，在静谧与喧嚣的交织中，踏上了一场反抗命运的旅程。
